item.description:
Final:Green Bay Packers 20 — New York Jets 17 (Final/OT)
Key stats:
  • Jets fell to 1-1 after a 20-17 overtime loss in their home opener at MetLife Stadium
  • Jets led 17-7 in the fourth quarter before the Packers scored the game's final 13 points
  • QB Geno Smith: 27-of-41 for 247 yards, 1 TD (to Garrett Wilson), 0 INT, 90.2 passer rating
  • WR Adonai Mitchell: 6 catches for 63 yards; WR Garrett Wilson: 5 catches for 57 yards and a TD
  • RB Breece Hall: 16 carries for 29 yards, plus 5 catches for 63 yards
  • Jets defense held Green Bay to 199 total yards and 1-of-9 on third down
  • HC Aaron Glenn: called it a tough way to lose, saying the team has things to fix
